title: Supersonic/Airwrap flashing red LED
shortDescription: Flashing red LED indicates a blocked filter or airflow fault.
fullDescription:
A flashing red light on the Dyson Supersonic or Airwrap typically indicates restricted airflow caused by a dirty filter or debris blockage. The motor bucket (cage) at the base accumulates lint, dust and hair which starves the digital motor of air.

If unaddressed, the tool enters protective cut-out mode. Clean the filter cage with the included brush and rinse the filter mesh under cold water as directed.

fixSteps.title: Unplug and cool
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect the tool and let it cool for 10 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Twist off filter cage
fixSteps.instruction: Rotate the filter cage at the base counter-clockwise and remove it.

fixSteps.title: Brush and rinse filter
fixSteps.instruction: Use the supplied filter cleaning brush, then rinse the cage under cold water and air-dry 24 hours.

whenToCallPro: If the red LED persists after a clean filter has fully dried, contact Dyson support for warranty service.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Supersonic flashing red light fix filter

faq.q: Can I use the tool while the filter dries?
faq.a: No. Moisture in the filter can damage the motor.

faq.q: How often should I clean the filter?
faq.a: Dyson recommends monthly cleaning for daily users.

title: Amber filter service indicator
shortDescription: Amber LED means the filter is due for cleaning soon.
fullDescription:
A solid or slow-pulsing amber LED is Dyson's pre-warning that filter airflow is degraded but not yet critical. Ignoring it will progress to a red flashing fault and eventual shutdown.

Clean the mesh cage and filter, then reset by powering the tool off and on.

fixSteps.title: Clean with brush
fixSteps.instruction: Use the cleaning brush to remove hair and lint.

fixSteps.title: Reassemble
fixSteps.instruction: Refit the cage until it clicks and power-cycle the tool.

whenToCallPro: Only if amber LED persists after a thorough clean and dry.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Airwrap amber light filter clean

title: Tool shuts off mid-use from overheating
shortDescription: Thermal cutout protects the motor when airflow is too low.
fullDescription:
The Supersonic and Airwrap include a thermal cutout that turns the tool off if internal temperatures exceed safe limits. This is usually caused by a blocked filter, covered inlet, or prolonged use on the hottest setting.

Allow the tool to cool for at least 10-15 minutes before restarting.

fixSteps.title: Cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Let the tool rest 10-15 minutes away from heat.

fixSteps.title: Clean filter
fixSteps.instruction: Clean the filter cage and mesh thoroughly.

fixSteps.title: Restart on cool setting
fixSteps.instruction: Turn on at low heat to verify airflow before increasing temperature.

whenToCallPro: If overheating recurs with a clean filter, have Dyson check the thermistor.

faq.a: Yes if not caused by filter neglect.

title: Tool will not power on
shortDescription: No response on power button usually indicates cable, outlet, or safety cutout.
fullDescription:
If your Supersonic or Airwrap does not power on, check the outlet, PRCD plug reset button, and cable for damage. Dyson hair tools include a PRCD (Portable Residual Current Device) on the plug that can trip.

Press the RESET button on the plug and verify the TEST/RESET status.

fixSteps.title: Test outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Plug another device into the same outlet to verify power.

fixSteps.title: Reset PRCD
fixSteps.instruction: Press RESET on the plug until it clicks.

fixSteps.title: Inspect cable
fixSteps.instruction: Check full length of cable for kinks, cuts, or exposed wire.

whenToCallPro: Cable/PRCD replacement must be done by Dyson service.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Supersonic wont turn on PRCD reset

faq.q: Can I replace the cable myself?
faq.a: No. The PRCD plug is integrated and sealed.

title: Airwrap barrels/brushes spin freely or feel loose
shortDescription: Barrel attachments not latched correctly reduce Coanda airflow.
fullDescription:
Airwrap attachments use a magnetic latch plus air channel seal. If the attachment wobbles or detaches during use, the seal is compromised and the Coanda curl effect fails.

Check the release collar and ensure the attachment clicks firmly. Remove hair wrapped around the base.

fixSteps.title: Remove attachment
fixSteps.instruction: Pull off and inspect the connection collar.

fixSteps.title: Clear hair/lint
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the latch area and clear any wrapped hair.

fixSteps.title: Reattach firmly
fixSteps.instruction: Align and press until you hear a click.

whenToCallPro: If the magnetic latch is damaged, Dyson can replace the base.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Airwrap attachment wont stay on

faq.a: No — it is magnetic, not mechanical.

title: Grinding, whining or rattling motor sound
shortDescription: Unusual noise signals bearing wear or internal debris.
fullDescription:
The Dyson digital motor (V9) runs at ~110,000 RPM. Grinding or rattling noise indicates foreign debris in the motor bucket or a failing bearing.

Do not continue using a noisy tool — it can damage the motor beyond repair.

fixSteps.title: Inspect filter cage
fixSteps.instruction: Remove cage and shine a light to check for loose debris.

fixSteps.title: Clean thoroughly
fixSteps.instruction: Brush and rinse the filter mesh; blow cage with canned air.

fixSteps.title: Test briefly
fixSteps.instruction: Run for 10 seconds — if noise persists, stop and contact Dyson.

whenToCallPro: Any grinding noise with a clean filter indicates motor service.

faq.a: Only by Dyson — the digital motor is sealed.

title: Airwrap barrel not curling hair
shortDescription: Coanda effect requires hair damp-dry and correct airflow direction.
fullDescription:
The Airwrap relies on the Coanda effect — air released through the barrel slots draws hair toward the curler. If hair is too wet, too dry, or the barrel arrow points wrong, curls will not form.

Ensure hair is ~80% dry and the directional arrow on the barrel matches your curl direction.

causes.cause: Hair too wet or too dry

fixSteps.title: Match barrel arrow
fixSteps.instruction: Point arrow toward the direction you want the curl to fall.

fixSteps.title: Check filter
fixSteps.instruction: Clean the filter cage to restore full airflow.

whenToCallPro: Usually technique, not hardware — pro service unnecessary.

faq.a: Yes — very thick or very fine hair needs section adjustments.

title: Heater not producing warm air
shortDescription: Heating element or thermistor failure limits tool to cold shot output.
fullDescription:
If the Supersonic or Airwrap blows only cold air regardless of heat setting, the heating element or temperature sensor has failed. This usually follows a moisture intrusion or a tripped internal thermal fuse.

This requires Dyson service — the heater is not a user-serviceable part.
symptoms: Heat LED normal but air cold

fixSteps.title: Check cold shot button
fixSteps.instruction: Verify the blue cold-shot button is not stuck depressed.

fixSteps.title: Contact Dyson
fixSteps.instruction: If still cold-only, schedule warranty service.

whenToCallPro: Any loss of heat requires Dyson warranty service.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Supersonic blowing cold only fix

faq.q: Is it safe to use on cold?
faq.a: Yes, but heat function must be repaired.
